subject: C-08B offline third increment:37 entries, river topology and entry gaps remain
body:
# C-08B: fixed displaced T1 increment, seeds9..12

2 October 2026. Third authorised batch complete and stopped:16 fresh candidates,32 planner invocations,12 new complete certificates and four unknown candidates. Cumulative offline version2 bank has37 accepted material entries plus a separately certified fallback. `complete:false`:27 entries and one river topology remain missing.

## Changed files and preservation

Claims preceded edits in `codex-C-08B.md`. Changed owned driver `scripts/dev/assemble-displaced-t1-bank.mjs`, tests `scripts/dev/test-displaced-t1-bank.mjs`, derived `docs/expeditions/v2/certification/four-locks/displaced-v1/bank-manifest.json`, parent report and this report. New immutable directories: `docs/expeditions/v2/certification/four-locks/displaced-v1/bank-candidates/tier-1-{river,islands,hedges,terraces}-seed-{9,10,11,12}/`.

Driver now accepts explicitly selected batches `1-4`, `5-8` and `9-12` only. A single allowlist defines their exact seed membership for generation, provenance verification and cumulative replay. Unsupported ranges fail before work. New request/result metadata records `batchId:9-12`; identity mismatches reject. No automatic next range, unknown retry or cap escalation. Previous optional batch metadata remains compatible and every old complete/unknown result is retained unchanged.

All268 prior evidence files, covering seed0 and seeds1..8, retain the matching before/after SHA256 `d65bf1de2826a8cf8d4bc0045c0cdce9ff059ed47889a0feef3106dae18e5390`. Digest covers sorted relative filenames and exact file bytes. Existing dirty changes were preserved. Runtime/default version1, Claude source, App/private access gate/rewards and shared build outputs were not edited. No new artwork was required for this offline increment.

## Executable checks and outcomes

```text
node scripts/dev/assemble-displaced-t1-bank.mjs --batch 9-12
node --test --test-reporter=spec scripts/dev/test-displaced-t1-bank.mjs expeditions/v2/generation/displaced-four-locks.test.js expeditions/v2/generation/runtime-generation.test.js scripts/dev/test-orchard-v2-certification.mjs
node scripts/dev/assemble-displaced-t1-bank.mjs --batch 9-12
```

All31 targeted checks pass. New checks enforce exact third-batch membership, immutable request identity, independent replay of all16 new packets, deterministic reconstruction of12 new accepted packets,32 request caps,27 wins, preserved older coverage and exact cumulative manifest membership/gaps. Prior tests continue to check production reducer/preview command hashes, actual printed card/stat assignments, target strength bands, different teams/output plans, real winning alcove endpoints, tampering, canonical duplicates, separate fallback, completeness boundaries and interrupted work without retry.

Initial invocation processed16/skipped0 with two8000-state requests each.27 new winning traces contain734 accepted commands. Each new `traces.json` is the executable production-reducer evidence; `result.json` records both requests/counters and the independently verified certificate. Actual disk resume processed0/skipped16, zero generator/planner calls, refreshing only the derived manifest.

Islands seed10 retains a real alcove win but lacks the direct win; hedges seed12 and terraces seed9 retain direct wins but lack alcove wins. River seed10 retains neither win. They remain unknown without retries; bounded search failure does not prove impossibility.

Known Claude-owned R-07 remains explicit: five exhausted calls report denied-spend overages10,17,1,7,7, total42. Requested caps remain8000. Reported counters do not establish actual admitted reducer work beyond the cap. No threshold, cost, enemy or planner change was made to obtain certificates.
